question: Does feedback-informed discovery cover more interpretable dynamical regimes in a broader inspectable rule/initial-state space, and yield reproducible art worth investigating?

budget.execution: serial CPU; one trajectory in memory; native data streamed; no per-cell model

measures.primary: 5×5×5 archive coverage from tail occupancy/activity/repeated4; search repeats are units
supplementary: engine/process/descriptor time and model use separately
measures.controls: existing saved stationary, periodic, noisy controls reanalyzed in C1; high scores do not establish life

information_access: all methods may access their own saved configuration, integer trajectory, fixed-palette visual and corrected descriptors; no cross-method outcome feedback to Codex before its final proposals. Random intentionally ignores feedback; novelty uses numerical vector. Codex sees all own trials in saved contact sheets plus numeric feedback. Algorithms and Codex know admissible profiles. Conversation prior knowledge is not experimentally erased.

policies.random: uniform untested index after identical four anchors
policies.novelty_archive: largest mean3-nearest descriptor-distance parent; uniform untested one-factor neighbor, fallback uniform remaining
policies.codex_feedback: two batches of six untested configurations per repeat, proposed here after viewing saved own-history contact sheets; reasons and input/output hashes retained

fixed_render: configs/palette.json; exact pixel raster, no smoothing; time downward; per-trial PNG and complete contact sheets
initial_conditions: iid or seeded 8-cell block repeated, with5% independently drawn jitter; apply sampled density then declared spatial mask. All design is at t0. Exact integer rows saved.
completion_criteria: 192 completed registered searches with equal update budgets
two logged Codex feedback rounds with saved visual evidence actually inspected
report every outcome and paired exploratory intervals without requiring Codex advantage
declare and complete R8b longer confirmation, interaction/perturbation/inheritance assays
three new trajectory-derived prints, streaming reveal animations, numeric close-ups and saved nearby worlds
synchronized README, record, atlas, register, replay checks and GitHub checkpoints

model_use.serving_model: not separately identified by this interface
model_use.exact_token_and_cost_metering: unavailable; retain conversation and proposal timestamps; do not invent quantities

next_decision: Select one occupied scientific candidate per method by highest retained signature count, then tail signature novelty, then coverage novelty, then earliest run. Separately curate visually expressive actual histories. R8b will use fresh seeds, longer horizons and bounded perturbations; negative results complete the round.
